settings.ourFreeModel.ann.f1: Model roster: availability, context length, vision, tunable thinking.

settings.ourFreeModel.ann.f5: Everything stays on this machine — no telemetry.
settings.ourFreeModel.ann.n1: Two new models are live on the EAC lane, relayed from OpenCode’s free tier: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Free and GLM 5.3 Flash Free.
settings.ourFreeModel.ann.n2: They lead the EAC models page, marked with a red NEW / 爆 badge and a “Fast” tag.
settings.ourFreeModel.ann.n3: Both expose real thinking levels (Low / High / Max), and DeepSeek can also switch thinking off; the level goes to the upstream as-is, not as a prompt hint.
settings.ourFreeModel.ann.p1: No credentials: install and use it — no sign-up, no API key to paste.
settings.ourFreeModel.ann.p2: The roster follows upstream: models, context lengths and capabilities are re-fetched on every refresh.
settings.ourFreeModel.ann.p3: Honest capability claims: anything a probe cannot confirm stays hidden, and each effort level is a real output budget.
settings.ourFreeModel.ann.pitch: All you do is install this plugin in dsh — no login, no sign-up, no API key, no other step of any kind. The frontier models are simply there, Muse Spark 1.3 and MiMo V2.6 among them. Completely free, with no usage cap.
settings.ourFreeModel.ann.s1: Pick any model under the “Our Free Model” group in the composer’s model selector.
settings.ourFreeModel.ann.s2: For harder reasoning, open the Effort menu — it sends a real budget, not a prompt hint.
settings.ourFreeModel.ann.s3: To serve other local tools: Settings → Local forward → enable, then copy the base URL and key.
settings.ourFreeModel.ann.s4: Region-limited models reclassify themselves once your network egress changes.
settings.ourFreeModel.ann.u1: Announcement center: pushes from the repository owner arrive live, with rich (HTML) layout.
settings.ourFreeModel.ann.u2: OS notifications: once enabled, new announcements and plugin updates raise system-level toasts.
settings.ourFreeModel.ann.u3: In-app upgrades: self-managed installs can update from settings; host-managed installs use their original installation method.
settings.ourFreeModel.ann.u4: Self-managed installs can use in-app upgrades and hot reload. For host-managed installs, update through the original installation method and reload as instructed by the host.

settings.ourFreeModel.picks.design.body: A local video-production and design plugin for DeepSeek Harness: multi-track editing, templates and a design system, a native preview canvas, and exports that are real files. The whole pipeline runs on this machine, so footage and projects stay on your own disk.
settings.ourFreeModel.picks.design.tagline: Finish video and design work locally, without handing your footage to anyone.
settings.ourFreeModel.picks.desktop.body: An open-source desktop workbench built on DeepSeek Harness: a Tauri native window with Node bundled in, so a double-click lands you in the work. Project files, session changes, a plugin catalog and a skin market in one place — with installers for Windows, Linux and macOS.
settings.ourFreeModel.picks.desktop.tagline: Agent capability, organized into a desktop that actually works.
settings.ourFreeModel.picks.foot: A star is the only payslip an open-source project gets — it decides how much more time the author can spend. Every project here is free, open source and ad-free; one click is the most concrete support there is.
settings.ourFreeModel.picks.liveFailed: GitHub numbers are unreachable right now; they will fill in later — the links below are unaffected.
settings.ourFreeModel.picks.pack.body: A catalog, batch install, update and removal manager for DSH Desktop, carrying 72 baseline sub-plugins, skin previews and prompt sets; a pinned digest manifest verifies every byte, so an install is complete and trustworthy.
settings.ourFreeModel.picks.pack.tagline: Embracing all creation: hundreds of DSH plugins, living together.
settings.ourFreeModel.picks.sub: A set of open-source projects by the same author: bringing the agent to a native desktop, keeping hundreds of plugins working together, and keeping video and design work on this machine. If they are useful, a star is the thanks they understand.

settings.ourFreeModel.saver.cavemanWhat: Terse replies: pleasantries and repeated explanation dropped, conclusions and code kept.
settings.ourFreeModel.saver.dashHint: Bytes actually compacted on this machine, written locally only.
settings.ourFreeModel.saver.local.filepathHint: Parses the file paths out of a command and its output, and returns them structured.
settings.ourFreeModel.saver.local.prefixHint: Answers the command prefix behind a permission prompt, parsed from the shell command.
settings.ourFreeModel.saver.local.quotaHint: Answers a "quota check" probe with a fixed line.
settings.ourFreeModel.saver.local.suggestionHint: Answers a suggestion-mode turn without producing an upstream request.
settings.ourFreeModel.saver.local.title: Session title
settings.ourFreeModel.saver.local.titleHint: Answers a title-generation request with a fixed title.
settings.ourFreeModel.saver.localHint: The answer to these five requests is already in the request body; forwarding one spends a round trip and upstream quota on a question with one right answer.
settings.ourFreeModel.saver.masterHint: Turning this off stops every saver at once and sends requests as written; the settings below are kept.
settings.ourFreeModel.saver.noData: No request measured yet. One conversation later, this shows real compacted bytes rather than an estimate.
settings.ourFreeModel.saver.ponytailWhat: YAGNI-minimal replies: only the one thing that was asked for, no unrequested abstraction, config or fallback.
settings.ourFreeModel.saver.promptHint: Appends a writing instruction to the system prompt. It is the only saver that can cut output tokens, because it changes what the model writes.
settings.ourFreeModel.saver.rtkSafety: Safety rules: an error result is left untouched, small bodies are not touched, and a blob is replaced only when the new text is non-empty and strictly smaller — a compacted result is never larger than the original.
settings.ourFreeModel.saver.rtkWhat: What it compacts: tool results — git diff / status / log, grep, find, ls, tree, build logs, numbered file dumps and duplicate log lines.
settings.ourFreeModel.saver.sub: Compact a request before it leaves this machine: tool output re-encoded, the prompt slimmed, and five answers produced locally without an upstream call.
settings.ourFreeModel.saver.title: Token savers
settings.ourFreeModel.saver.voiceWarn: Heads-up: both families change how the assistant talks, and that lands in your transcript. Off by default.
